en: Proverbs 18

p.src: 1  A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.

ja: い、 すべての確かな判断に
en: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
u.src: 1  A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.

p.src: 2  A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.

en: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.
u.src: 2  A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.

p.src: 3  When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.

en: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.
u.src: 3  When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.

p.src: 4  The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.

en: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.
u.src: 4  The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.

p.src: 5  To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.

ja: をえこひいきすることも、 罪のない
から公正を奪うことも良くない。
en: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.
u.src: 5  To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.

p.src: 6  A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.

en: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.
u.src: 6  A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.

p.src: 7  A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.

en: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
u.src: 7  A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.

p.src: 8  The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.

en: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.
u.src: 8  The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.

p.src: 9  One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.

en: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.
u.src: 9  One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.

p.src: 10  The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

ja: である。 義人はそこへ
en: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
u.src: 10  The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

p.src: 11  The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.

en: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
u.src: 11  The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.

p.src: 12  Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.

ja: つのはへりくだりである。
en: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.
u.src: 12  Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.

p.src: 13  He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.

en: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.
u.src: 13  He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.

p.src: 14  A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?

ja: えるが、 打ち砕かれた心には誰が
en: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?
u.src: 14  A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?

p.src: 15  The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

en: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
u.src: 15  The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

p.src: 16  A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.

ja: き、 身分の高い者たちの
en: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.
u.src: 16  A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.

p.src: 17  He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.

en: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.
u.src: 17  He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.

p.src: 18  The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.

en: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.
u.src: 18  The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.

p.src: 19  A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.

ja: よりも取り戻しにくく、
いは要塞のかんぬきのようだ。
en: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.
u.src: 19  A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.

p.src: 20  A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.

en: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.
u.src: 20  A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.

p.src: 21  Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.

ja: にある。 舌を使うことを好む
en: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
u.src: 21  Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.

p.src: 22  Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of the LORD.

ja: いものを見つけ、 主から好意を
en: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of the LORD.
u.src: 22  Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of the LORD.

p.src: 23  The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.

en: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.
u.src: 23  The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.

p.src: 24  A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

ja: 多くの仲間を持つ人は滅びることがあるが、
en: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
u.src: 24  A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
